lines.text: MOVE TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-ENTRY(TAG-INDEX, TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-LENGTH(TAG-INDEX)) TO TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-ENTRY(TAG-INDEX, TAG-ENTRY-INDEX)

blocks.cond: varying OTHER-ENTRY-INDEX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL OTHER-ENTRY-INDEX > TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-LENGTH(OTHER-TAG-INDEX)
blocks.label: loop_header

lines.text: *> swap the last entry into the current position
MOVE TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-ENTRY(TAG-INDEX, TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-LENGTH(TAG-INDEX)) TO TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-ENTRY(TAG-INDEX, TAG-ENTRY-INDEX)
*> copy the other tag's entries to the end of the current tag's entries - but avoid duplicates!
PERFORM VARYING OTHER-ENTRY-INDEX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL OTHER-ENTRY-INDEX > TAGS-CURRENT-TAG-LENGTH(OTHER-TAG-INDEX)
